cards.answer: Zeri is an AD-focused marksman who fights with aimed Burst Fire attacks and can dash across terrain. Her ultimate rewards continued champion hits with sustained empowerment and stacking movement speed.
cards.counterplay: Dodge her firing line and disengage during her ultimate to limit continued champion hits.

cards.answer: Living Battery: Moving and casting Burst Fire build charge for Zeri's basic attack. Her basic attack deals magic damage and applies spell effects rather than on-hit effects; at full charge, it deals increased damage that includes a portion of the target's maximum health.
cards.counterplay: Limit close trades when her charged attack is available.

cards.answer: Burst Fire: Zeri fires aimed rounds that deal physical damage to the first enemy hit. It functions as a basic attack, can critically strike and applies on-hit effects. Attack speed reduces its cooldown, and silence does not stop her from casting it.
cards.counterplay: Move across her firing line and use minions as cover when her piercing empowerment is inactive; avoid relying on silence to stop her fire.

cards.answer: Ultrashock Laser: Zeri fires a pulse that damages and slows the first enemy hit. Hitting terrain transforms it into a delayed, long-range line laser that damages and slows enemies hit and critically strikes champions.
cards.counterplay: Avoid lining up behind terrain in her firing direction; move sideways out of the laser's path.

citations.quote: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit.

facts.claim: Zeri fires a pulse that damages and slows the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: If the pulse hits a wall it expands into a long range laser.

If the pulse hits terrain, it transforms into a laser in a line that grants sight of the area for 1.75 seconds and fires after 0.85 seconds, applying the same effects to enemies hit and critically striking for (150% + 15%) damage against champions and monsters.

facts.claim: Hitting terrain transforms it into a delayed, long-range line laser that damages and slows enemies hit and critically strikes champions.

cards.priority_reason: Terrain changes the pulse into a broader threat to enemies behind it.

cards.answer: Spark Surge: Zeri dashes and can travel across terrain. Afterwards, Burst Fire temporarily pierces enemies and deals bonus magic damage to the first enemy hit. Charged attacks and Burst Fire hits reduce the dash's remaining cooldown, with greater reduction from critical Burst Fire hits.
cards.counterplay: Expect escapes across walls and avoid lining up behind allies during her piercing attacks; deny continued hits to limit her dash refresh.

Lightning Rounds: Burst Fire deals bonus magic damage to the first enemy hit and will pierce through enemies to deal modified damage.

facts.claim: Afterwards, Burst Fire temporarily pierces enemies and deals bonus magic damage to the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: Spark Surge's cooldown is reduced if Zeri hits an enemy with a charged basic attack or Burst Fire. Burst Fire reduces the cooldown even more if it critically strikes.

facts.claim: Charged attacks and Burst Fire hits reduce the dash's remaining cooldown, with greater reduction from critical Burst Fire hits.

cards.priority_reason: Combines terrain escape, piercing damage and a cooldown that accelerates through combat.

cards.answer: Lightning Crash: Zeri deals magic damage around herself; hitting a champion activates Overcharged, granting attack speed, movement speed and faster Burst Fire that chains physical damage to nearby enemies. Ability and charged attack hits on champions extend Overcharged and build temporary movement speed stacks; further hits refresh those stacks.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and break contact during Overcharged to limit chain damage and continued movement speed stacking.
